description: This file contains unit tests for the HandleBusMessage task in a GStreamer-based media playback system. It tests handling of various GStreamer bus messages such as EOS, state changes, QoS, and errors, ensuring correct notification and state management within the media pipeline.

classes.name: HandleBusMessageTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for handling GStreamer bus message tests, setting up mock objects and test environment.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleMessageWithUnknownType
methods.description: Test that messages with unknown types are not handled and are unreferenced.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleEosMessageForAnotherPipeline
methods.description: Test that EOS messages from a different pipeline are ignored.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleMessageEosWhenPipelineIsNull
methods.description: Test that EOS messages are ignored when the pipeline is null.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleMessageEosWhenEosAlreadyNotified
methods.description: Test that EOS messages are ignored if EOS has already been notified.

methods.name: shouldHandleEosMessage
methods.description: Test handling of EOS message, notifying end of stream and setting notification flag.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleStateChangedMessageForAnotherPipeline
methods.description: Test that state change messages from a different pipeline are ignored.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleMessageStateChangedWhenPipelineIsNull
methods.description: Test that state change messages are ignored when pipeline is null.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleStateChangedMessageWhenGstPlayerClientIsNull
methods.description: Test that state change messages are ignored if the player client is null.

methods.name: shouldHandleStateChangedToNullMessage
methods.description: Test handling of state change to NULL, notifying stopped state.

methods.name: shouldHandleStateChangedToPausedMessage
methods.description: Test handling of state change to PAUSED, notifying paused state.

methods.name: shouldHandleStateChangedToPausedAndPendingPausedMessage
methods.description: Test handling of paused state with pending paused, no notification.

methods.name: shouldHandleStateChangedToPlayingMessage
methods.description: Test handling of state change to PLAYING, notifying playing state and starting timers.

methods.name: shouldHandleStateChangedToPlayingMessageAndSetPendingPlaybackRate
methods.description: Test handling of playing state with a pending playback rate, setting the rate.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleQosMessageForUnsupportedFormat
methods.description: Test that QoS messages with undefined format are ignored.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleQosMessageForUnknownSourceType
methods.description: Test that QoS messages from unknown source types are ignored.

methods.name: shouldHandleQosMessageForVideo
methods.description: Test QoS message handling for video source, notifying QoS info.

methods.name: shouldHandleQosMessageForAudio
methods.description: Test QoS message handling for audio source, notifying QoS info.

methods.name: shouldHandleErrorMessageNoEos
methods.description: Test error message handling, notifying failure for non-stream errors.

methods.name: shouldHandleErrorMessageWhenEosAllSources
methods.description: Test error handling when all sources are EOS, notifying failure.

methods.name: shouldHandleStreamErrorMessageNoEos
methods.description: Test stream error handling, notifying failure when not all sources are EOS.

methods.name: shouldHandleStreamErrorMessageWhenEosSingleSource
methods.description: Test stream error handling when only one source is EOS, notifying failure.

methods.name: shouldHandleStreamErrorMessageWhenEosAllSources
methods.description: Test stream error handling when all sources are EOS, notifying end of stream.

methods.name: shouldHandleStreamErrorMessageWhenEosAllSourcesAndEosAlreadyNotfied
methods.description: Test stream error handling when all sources are EOS but EOS already notified, no duplicate notification.
